question: In the RSC Advances study of biochar loading in dual-phase MIL-100(Al)/MIL-110(Al) hybrids for CO2 adsorption, what BET surface area, micropore surface area and total pore volume did BC-10 have?
rendered: BC-10 had a BET surface area of 496.79 m2 g−1, a micropore surface area of 372.99 m2 g−1, and a total pore volume of 0.274 cm3 g−1.
